_comment_server_host: IP/interface for the VPS exit server to listen on. 0.0.0.0 accepts external connections.
_comment_server_port: TCP port for /healthz, /tunnel, and /stream. Must match Code.gs RELAY_URLS and VPS firewall rules.
_comment_tunnel_key: Same 64-character hex key as client_config.json tunnel_key.
_comment_upstream_proxy: Optional SOCKS5 proxy for VPS outbound traffic, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:40000 for local WARP, or socks5://user:pass@host:port if your proxy requires auth. Leave empty for direct VPS egress.
_comment_debug_timing: Set true only while diagnosing VPS-side DNS/TCP dial latency.
_comment_stats_json: Set true to emit periodic server stats as JSON log lines for later analysis.
_comment_debug_pprof_addr: Optional local pprof listen address for deep profiling, e.g. 127.0.0.1:6061. Leave empty unless actively profiling.
_comment_write_startup_diagnostics: Set true to write one redacted diagnostics zip on startup, then continue running normally.
_comment_diagnostics_output_dir: Directory for startup diagnostics zips. Relative paths are created beside the server binary. Empty uses diagnostics/ beside the binary. Docker Compose maps ./diagnostics to /app/diagnostics.
_comment_save_terminal_log: Set true during field tests to keep printing logs in the terminal and also save the same run to a .log file for later debugging. Terminal logs are not redacted; review destination hostnames/IPs and any full direct URLs/tokens before sharing.
_comment_terminal_log_file: Optional log filename/prefix for save_terminal_log. Relative paths are created beside the server binary. Empty auto-creates logs/goose-server-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.log. A custom path still creates a fresh timestamped file every run.
_comment_auto_tune: When true, adjusts only active_drain_window_ms and coalesce windows inside fixed safety caps. Beginners should leave false until real logs show a tuning need.
_comment_performance_mode: latency is best for browsing, video start, Google Play, and chat apps. throughput uses larger waits for stable bulk downloads but can make weak mobile links feel slower.
_comment_active_drain_window_ms: Max time the server waits for downstream data after receiving client frames. Lower improves page-start latency.
_comment_long_poll_window_ms: Max time the server holds an idle poll open. 8000 reduces idle Apps Script quota burn versus 6000 while active data still returns immediately.
_comment_upstream_dial_timeout_ms: TCP dial timeout from VPS to target websites. 8000 fails dead edges faster than the conservative default.
_comment_coalesce_window_ms: Server response coalescing while not busy. 0 is best for low latency.
_comment_coalesce_window_busy_ms: Server response coalescing while many sessions are active. 0 keeps responses immediate.
_comment_max_sessions: Maximum concurrent server-side tunnel sessions. Protects small VPS instances from connection storms.
_comment_max_drain_frames_per_session: Server-only download fairness knob. It limits how many 256 KiB downstream frames one hot TCP session can take from a single server response. 8 is the safe browsing/video default (about 2 MiB plaintext per response for one session). 16 is a good first bulk-download test (about 4 MiB). 24 and 32 are increasingly aggressive for single large downloads; they can improve Google Play-style downloads, but other tabs/videos may wait longer and Apps Script responses get larger. Keep 8 for mixed browsing, try 16 first for download testing, then try 24 or 32 only if quota, latency, and packet loss stay healthy.
_comment_max_request_body_bytes: Max encrypted HTTP request body accepted by /tunnel. 12 MiB fits the default 8 MiB upload batch after Apps Script/base64 expansion while limiting unauthenticated request memory.
_comment_max_response_bytes_pre_encode: Max plaintext response batch before encryption/base64 after the startup ramp. 2097152 is safest for unstable Android/mobile links; 4194304 is conservative; 6291456 is the balanced download default. With replay enabled, keep this at or below 8388608. Raising toward 23068672 is expert-only for stable links with replay disabled.
_comment_initial_response_cap_enabled: Set false to ignore initial_response_bytes_pre_encode without editing the byte number. Useful for maximum bulk-download testing.
_comment_initial_response_bytes_pre_enco: Caps each session's first downstream response so headers and first bytes reach the browser quickly when initial_response_cap_enabled is true.
_comment_second_response_cap_enabled: Set false to ignore second_response_bytes_pre_encode without editing the byte number.
_comment_second_response_bytes_pre_encod: Caps each session's second downstream response when second_response_cap_enabled is true. 1048576 is smoother for Apps Script/mobile video starts; try 2097152 only if downloads are stable and quota is healthy.
_comment_downstream_replay_enabled: Lost-response recovery for Apps Script/direct POST. Keep enabled for mobile/video continuity when the client uses downstream_replay_mode=auto. It uses bounded VPS memory to replay lost downstream responses; it is for reliability, not raw speed.
